login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your production desk.

forgot.hint: Enter your account e-mail. We will send a reset link.

reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.successHint: Every other device was signed out. Sign in again with your new password.
reset.missingToken: This reset link cannot be used
